key_insight: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks exploit neural-network hierarchy to process model weights more efficiently while preserving permutation symmetries.
engineering_relevance: H-GMNs enable deeper metanetwork processing for model evaluation, backdoor detection and pruning without the memory growth of flat graph metanetworks.
method: Represent neural networks as graphs with neuron-, layer- and block-level structure.
Coarsen and refine graphs using permutation-symmetry-preserving pooling and unpooling.
Extend hierarchical processing to Transformers through a symmetry-preserving graph construction.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on ResNet-18, ViT and varying-ViT model zoos with up to 86M parameters report improved sample efficiency and nearly constant cost as metanetwork depth increases, without sacrificing accuracy.
watch_item: Nearly constant cost applies to increasing metanetwork depth, not necessarily increasing input-model size; constructing and processing the initial weight graph may still be costly.
